list.name: Button
list.description: Thirteen variants from plain to glow, shine and 3D press, pill shape, five sizes, loading state, and asChild for links.

list.name: Input
list.description: Text input and textarea with icon, trailing slot, and invalid state.

list.name: Label and Field
list.description: Label with required marker, plus Field for label, control and hint or error.

list.name: Checkbox
list.description: Checked, unchecked and indeterminate. Works for select-all rows.

list.name: Switch
list.description: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately.

list.name: Select
list.description: Styled dropdown with groups, built on Radix Select.

list.name: Combobox
list.description: Searchable select, single or multiple, with descriptions under each option.

list.name: Calendar
list.description: Month grid for one day or a range. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End work.

list.name: Date picker
list.description: Date and date range fields that open a calendar. The range picker has optional quick presets (Last 7 days, This month...) and a day count. Closes on pick.

list.name: Phone input
list.description: Phone field with a country picker. Groups digits as you type and hands back the E.164 number and whether it is complete.

list.name: Signature pad
list.description: Draw-your-signature canvas for mouse, touch and pen. Sharp on retina screens, exports a PNG.

list.name: Event calendar
list.description: Month view with events on their days, multi-day spans, +n more overflow, locale-aware names and RTL arrows.

list.name: Virtual list
list.description: Windowed list that renders only the visible rows. 100,000 items stay smooth.

list.name: Circle pack chart
list.description: One bubble per item, area by value, packed into a cluster. Bubbles pop out from the center biggest first; hover for the share.

list.name: Marimekko chart
list.description: Stacked 100% bars whose widths also mean something: column width is group size, block height is mix. Columns grow up on scroll.

list.name: Punch card chart
list.description: A grid of dots where dot size is the value, like commits by weekday and hour. Dots pop in on a diagonal wave.

list.name: Forecast chart
list.description: Solid line for what happened, dashed line inside a shaded band for what is expected. The band is the likely range.

list.name: Venn chart
list.description: Two or three overlapping circles with a count in every region: who is in one group, who is in several.

list.name: Word cloud
list.description: Words sized by how often they appear, biggest in the middle. Words grow in; hover to focus one, or make them clickable filters.

list.name: Week strip
list.description: Seven day pills with previous and next week arrows, a selected day and dots under days that have something. Arrow keys move the day.

list.name: Order tracker
list.description: Delivery progress as steps joined by a line that fills up to the current one. Horizontal on wide screens, vertical on phones.

list.name: Diff viewer
list.description: Before and after text as a unified diff: red removed lines, green added lines, line numbers, and unchanged stretches folded.

list.name: Day agenda
list.description: One day as a time grid: events sit at their time, overlapping ones share the width, a red now-line marks the time.

list.name: Pie chart
list.description: Slices of one whole that sweep around on scroll. Hover a slice or legend row and it pulls out.

list.name: Half donut chart
list.description: A semicircle split into parts with a total under the arch. Half the height of a donut, so it fits dashboard cards.

list.name: Radial line chart
list.description: A line chart bent into a circle for things that repeat: 24 hours, 12 months. A smooth closed shape grows from the middle.

list.name: Histogram chart
list.description: Counts how many values fall in each range from raw data, with a smooth curve over the bars. Bars rise in turn.

list.name: Pareto chart
list.description: Causes sorted by size as bars plus a running-total line with an 80% mark. Shows which few causes matter most.

list.name: Slope chart
list.description: One line per item between two moments. Steep means big change, crossing means swapped places. Green rose, red fell.

list.name: Butterfly chart
list.description: Two bar sets back to back around shared rows, like a population pyramid. Bars grow outward from the middle.

list.name: Lollipop chart
list.description: A bar chart as a thin stick with a dot on the end, sorted largest first. Lighter than bars when there are many items.

list.name: Sunburst chart
list.description: A hierarchy as concentric rings: each ring splits its parent. Rings sweep outward; hover a slice to light up its parents and children.

list.name: Ridgeline chart
list.description: One smooth curve per row, overlapping like mountain ridges on a shared scale. Ridges rise in turn; hover one to bring it forward.

list.name: Box plot chart
list.description: Spread per group: box for the middle half, median line, whiskers and outlier dots. Boxes open from the median; hover for the five numbers.

list.name: Chord chart
list.description: Flow between every pair of items around a circle. Arcs sweep in, then ribbons fade in; hover an item to keep only its ribbons.

list.name: Uptime bar
list.description: Status-page strip with one tick per day in green, amber or red, the uptime percentage and an incident note on hover.

list.name: Leaderboard
list.description: Ranked people or teams with avatars, score bars, gold, silver and bronze badges and place changes. Sorted for you; bars fill in on scroll.

list.name: Rating breakdown
list.description: Review summary: big average, stars and a bar per star level. Rows can act as filters. Bars fill in on scroll.

list.name: Credit card
list.description: Payment card preview that flips in 3D to show the CVV. Formats as the user types, guesses Visa, Mastercard, AmEx or RuPay, and can mask the number.

list.name: Bump chart
list.description: Rank over time as smooth lines that swap places. Lines draw in one by one; hover a line or name to follow it.

list.name: Rose chart
list.description: Polar area chart: equal-angle petals whose length is the value. Petals bloom from the center in turn; hover one to read it.

list.name: Bullet chart
list.description: A KPI against its target in one thin row, with shaded bands for poor, ok and good. The bar slides in on scroll.

list.name: Dumbbell chart
list.description: Change per item as two dots joined by a line: before and after, plan and actual. Green when good, red when bad.

list.name: Waffle chart
list.description: A grid of 100 squares, each one percent of the whole. Squares pop in as a wave; hover a legend row to light up its squares.

list.name: Treemap
list.description: Tiles sized by value, packed to stay square. Budget by team, revenue by product. Spring in on scroll; hover lifts one tile and dims the rest.

list.name: Waterfall chart
list.description: How a start number becomes an end number: green adds, red subtracts, blue totals. Bars drop in one after another with connector lines.

list.name: Sankey chart
list.description: Flow diagram where ribbon width is the amount: traffic to page to outcome, budget to team. Ribbons draw in; hover follows a flow.

list.name: Stream chart
list.description: Streamgraph: smooth stacked flows around a center line to show shifts in mix over time. Ripples in from the left; hover a flow to focus it.

list.name: Candlestick chart
list.description: Open, high, low and close per period. Green closed up, red closed down. Candles grow from their midpoint in sequence; hover for the four numbers.

list.name: Area chart
list.description: Smooth gradient areas, stacked or overlapping, that wipe in on scroll. Hover for a readout across series.

list.name: Scatter chart
list.description: Scatter and bubble chart with axis labels, groups by color and a nearest-point hover. Points pop in one by one on scroll.

list.name: Matrix heatmap
list.description: Rows by columns shaded by value: traffic by hour and weekday, cohort retention. Cells fade in as a wave; hover lights up the row and column.

list.name: Stacked bar chart
list.description: Bars split into colored segments that grow in on scroll, with a hover breakdown and legend. Sessions by device, revenue by plan.

list.name: Radial bar chart
list.description: Concentric rings, one per goal, that sweep in on scroll. Legend hover highlights a ring; the middle takes any content.

list.name: Live chart
list.description: Streaming line chart that slides left as new values arrive. You give it a function for the next value; pause it any time.

list.name: Pivot table
list.description: Cross-tab of your rows: one field down the side, another across the top, sum, count, average, min or max in each cell, with totals and heat shading.

list.name: Tree table
list.description: Table whose rows have child rows. Expand and collapse branches by click or arrow keys.

list.name: File uploader
list.description: Multi-file drop area with a progress bar per file, cancel, retry and a concurrency limit. You supply the upload function.

list.name: Onboarding carousel
list.description: Mobile first-run intro with swipeable slides, dots, Skip and a final Get started button.

list.name: Segmented control
list.description: Pick one of a few views or ranges. Smaller than tabs.

list.name: Theme toggle
list.description: Icon button that flips light and dark mode and remembers the choice. Also exports a useTheme hook.

list.name: User menu
list.description: Avatar button for the topbar that opens a menu with name, email, your links and Sign out.

list.name: Settings layout
list.description: Settings page frame: vertical section list on the left, SettingsSection rows (title and help on the left, controls on the right).

list.name: Description list
list.description: Label and value pairs for a details panel, in one to three columns, optionally with dividers.

list.name: Bar list
list.description: Ranked list with a bar behind each row: top pages, products, sources, countries.

list.name: Comparison table
list.description: Plans across the top, features down the side, a check, dash or text in each cell. For pricing pages.

list.name: Invoice
list.description: Printable invoice with number, status, from and bill-to, line items, tax and total computed from the lines.

list.name: Landing sections
list.description: Marketing page parts: Hero, LogoStrip, FeatureGrid, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner and SiteFooter. Stack them with a Navbar.

list.name: Accordion
list.description: Collapsible sections with a smooth height animation. Single or multiple open.

list.name: Spotlight card
list.description: Card with a glow and border highlight that follow the cursor.

list.name: Border beam
list.description: A light beam that circles the border. For pricing cards and featured content.

list.name: Marquee
list.description: Endless logo or tag scroll with edge fade. Pauses on hover.

list.name: Number ticker
list.description: Counts up to a value with easing once it scrolls into view.

list.name: Reveal
list.description: Scroll-in fade-up wrapper and a blur-in headline. One IntersectionObserver each.

list.name: Copy button
list.description: Copies text and morphs to a check.

list.name: OTP input
list.description: Code boxes with paste, backspace, arrow keys, autofill and a shake on error.

list.name: Slider
list.description: Native range input with a filled track and floating value bubble.

list.name: Dropzone
list.description: Drag and drop file area with size check and removable file list.

list.name: Radio group
list.description: Native radios as selectable cards with descriptions.

list.name: Rating
list.description: Star rating with hover preview. Read-only when no handler is given.

list.name: Tag input
list.description: Type and press Enter to add chips. Backspace removes the last.

list.name: Number stepper
list.description: Number field with plus and minus buttons and arrow keys.

list.name: Chip
list.description: Toggleable filter chips, single or multi select.

list.name: Carousel
list.description: Scroll-snap slides with arrows and animated dots.

list.name: Image compare
list.description: Before and after slider. Drag or use arrow keys.

list.name: Tilt card
list.description: 3D card that tilts toward the cursor with a moving sheen.

list.name: Shimmer text
list.description: Text with a light sweep passing over it.

list.name: Countdown
list.description: Live countdown with flipping digits.

list.name: Progress ring
list.description: Circular progress with an eased stroke animation.

list.name: Banner
list.description: Announcement bar that collapses smoothly when dismissed.

list.name: Scroll progress
list.description: Thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or a container.

list.name: Tree view
list.description: Nested expandable list with animated open and close.

list.name: Toggle
list.description: Two-state button for favourite, bold or mute. Announces its state to screen readers.

list.name: Toggle group
list.description: A row of toggles where one or several can be pressed, for formatting toolbars.

list.name: Button group
list.description: Buttons joined into one row or column with shared borders and rounded outer corners.

list.name: Input group
list.description: One field with text, icons or buttons attached at the start or end, like https:// or .com.

list.name: Search input
list.description: Search field with a clear button, Escape to clear and a slash shortcut to focus.

list.name: Password input
list.description: Show and hide toggle with an optional strength meter.

list.name: Color picker
list.description: Swatches, hex field and the native picker. Always returns a six-digit hex.

list.name: Collapsible
list.description: One section that opens with a smooth height animation.

list.name: Dock
list.description: Icons that grow toward the pointer, like the macOS dock.

list.name: Data table
list.description: Sortable columns, a search box and pagination, with optional row selection and bulk actions, column visibility menu, sticky header, toolbar slot, row action menus and clickable rows. You pass rows and column definitions.

list.name: Gauge
list.description: Half-circle meter with a needle that swings to the value.

list.name: Typewriter
list.description: Types, holds and deletes phrases in a loop. Static for reduced motion.

list.name: Confetti
list.description: Burst of confetti from any button, or call fireConfetti(x, y) yourself.

list.name: Alert dialog
list.description: Confirm before something destructive. Cancel and confirm, controlled by you.

list.name: Time picker
list.description: Hour, minute and AM/PM segments you type into or step with arrow keys. 12 or 24 hour.

list.name: Analog clock
list.description: SVG clock for any time zone, with a second hand that ticks with a small bounce.

list.name: World clock
list.description: Cities with live local time, a day or night icon and the hour difference from you.

list.name: Stopwatch
list.description: Start, pause, lap and reset, down to hundredths of a second.

list.name: Timer
list.description: Countdown with a ring that drains smoothly, presets and an onDone callback.

list.name: Relative time
list.description: "3 minutes ago", kept live. Hover for the full date. Uses Intl, so it speaks your locale.

list.name: Heatmap
list.description: Contribution-style grid for daily activity. Cells pop in column by column.

list.name: Pricing card
list.description: Plan card whose price counts to the new value. The highlighted plan gets a travelling border beam.

list.name: Changelog
list.description: Release notes: version and date on the left, tagged New, Improved, Fixed or Removed changes on the right.

list.name: Testimonial card
list.description: Customer quote with avatar, role and optional star rating.

list.name: Comment thread
list.description: Nested comments with inline reply boxes, three levels deep.

list.name: Code block
list.description: Code with a title, optional line numbers and a copy button. No highlighter dependency.

list.name: Status dot
list.description: Small status light with an optional pulse and label.

list.name: Search bar
list.description: Search field with live results, highlighted matches, recent searches and full keyboard control.

list.name: Currency input
list.description: Money field that groups digits as you type (1,25,000) and hands you a plain number.

list.name: Inline edit
list.description: Text that becomes a field on click. Enter saves, Escape cancels.

list.name: Kanban board
list.description: Columns of draggable cards. Drag with the mouse or move a focused card with Alt and the arrow keys. Controlled, no drag library.

list.name: Activity feed
list.description: Who did what and when, grouped under Today and Yesterday, with live relative times and an optional quoted detail.

list.name: Permission matrix
list.description: Roles by permissions grid of checkboxes with per-column toggle and locked roles.

list.name: Filter bar
list.description: Removable filter chips with an Add filter menu: pick a field, then a value.

list.name: Notification center
list.description: Bell with an unread count and a popover list. Click marks read, Mark all read clears it.

list.name: Cookie consent
list.description: Bottom-left consent card that remembers Accept or Decline.

list.name: Table of contents
list.description: On this page list that highlights the section currently in view.

list.name: Product card
list.description: Product tile with image, rating, price with strike-through, discount tag, wishlist heart and Add button. Also exports Price.

list.name: Coupon input
list.description: Promo code field with async validation, an error message and a removable applied chip.

list.name: Order summary
list.description: Cart lines with subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and total computed for you. Slots for a coupon field and a checkout button.

list.name: Split pane
list.description: Two resizable panels with a draggable divider. Keyboard resizable. Horizontal or vertical.

list.name: Sortable list
list.description: Reorder rows by dragging, or with arrow keys on the grip. Controlled, no drag library.

list.name: Chat
list.description: Message bubbles with avatars, timestamps, a typing indicator and a composer. Enter sends.

list.name: Mention input
list.description: Textarea that suggests people when you type @. Arrow keys and Enter pick.

list.name: Profile card
list.description: Person card with banner, avatar, role, stats and an actions slot.

list.name: Terminal
list.description: Dark terminal window with prompt lines and output. Optional typing animation.

list.name: Navbar
list.description: Top bar with brand, links and actions that folds into a menu on small screens.

list.name: Menubar
list.description: Desktop-app style bar of menus (File, Edit, View) with shortcuts and checkable items.

list.name: Navigation menu
list.description: Desktop top-bar menu whose items open mega-menu panels, with keyboard and focus handled.

list.name: Bottom navigation
list.description: Mobile tab bar with icons, labels, an active pill and count badges.

list.name: Floating action button
list.description: Round primary action, extended with a label, or a speed dial that fans out actions.

list.name: Error state
list.description: Full-section error or not found screen with a code or icon, explanation and retry actions.

list.name: Image viewer
list.description: Lightbox with arrows, click to zoom and keyboard control.

list.name: Line chart
list.description: Multi-series line or area chart in plain SVG with grid, axis labels, legend and a hover readout.

list.name: Radar chart
list.description: Spider chart for several scores on the same axes: a pentagon with five, a hexagon with six. Shapes grow from the center on scroll; hover a legend name to highlight a series.

list.name: Audit log
list.description: Who changed what and when, with expandable before and after values.

list.name: File manager
list.description: Folder browser with breadcrumb, list and grid views, selection and double-click or Enter to open.

list.name: Swipe actions
list.description: List row you swipe left to reveal action buttons. Touch, mouse drag and keyboard.

list.name: Pull to refresh
list.description: Scroll area you pull down from the top to refresh, with a spinner until your promise settles.

list.name: Date and time picker
list.description: One field for a day and a time: calendar on top, time picker below.

list.name: Image upload
list.description: Thumbnail grid with remove buttons, a cover label and a drop tile. Limits count, type and size.

list.name: Bottom sheet
list.description: Sheet that rises from the bottom, with a drag handle to dismiss. Radix Dialog underneath.

list.name: Avatar upload
list.description: Click-to-change profile picture with instant preview, size and type checks, and a Remove link.

list.name: Schema form
list.description: Build a form from a description: text, email, number, date, select, textarea and checkbox fields, validation, and optional multi-step wizard with a stepper.

list.name: Rich text editor
list.description: Small editor with bold, italic, underline, heading, lists, quote and link. Value is HTML. Built on contentEditable, no dependency.

list.name: Notification preferences
list.description: Grid of events by channel (email, push, SMS, in-app) with a switch per cell and a switch per channel.

list.name: Saved views
list.description: Menu of saved table setups: pick one, save the current one under a name, delete.

list.name: Funnel chart
list.description: Conversion funnel with a bar per stage and the step-to-step rate.

list.name: Gantt chart
list.description: Schedule view with a bar per task, progress fill, weekend shading and a today line.

list.name: Org chart
list.description: Reporting tree with connector lines and collapsible teams.

list.name: Approval flow
list.description: Chain of approvers with decisions, comments and times. The current approver gets Approve and Reject buttons.

list.name: Onboarding checklist
list.description: Getting-started card with a progress bar, tick-off items, short help text and actions. Collapsible.

list.name: Tag manager
list.description: Create, rename, recolor and delete labels, with usage counts.

list.name: Shortcuts dialog
list.description: Keyboard cheat sheet that opens on ? and shows grouped shortcuts as keycaps.

list.name: Format helpers
list.description: formatCurrency, formatCompact, formatPercent, formatBytes, formatDuration and a signed Currency component. Indian rupees by default.

list.name: Version log
list.description: Animated version history: the rail draws and dots pop as releases scroll in, entries slide in one by one, releases fold open, with a version jump strip and a kind filter.

list.name: Card
list.description: Bordered surface with header, content and footer parts.

list.name: Brand icons
list.description: Logos of popular services as single-colour SVGs that follow the text colour, for sign-in buttons and integration lists.

list.name: Badge
list.description: Status pill with semantic colors and an optional dot.

list.name: Avatar
list.description: Image with initials fallback in a stable color. Five sizes, circle or square, presence dot (online, away, busy, offline), a stacked group with hover names, and UserInfo for avatar plus name and subtitle.

list.name: Table
list.description: Dense table parts with hover rows, a selected state, footer and caption.

list.name: Separator
list.description: Horizontal or vertical divider.

list.name: Kbd
list.description: Keyboard key hint.

list.name: Empty state
list.description: Dashed placeholder with icon, text and an action.

list.name: Timeline
list.description: Vertical activity feed with tone-colored markers.

list.name: Stat card
list.description: KPI tile with value, trend delta and a sparkline slot.

list.name: Charts
list.description: Sparkline, bar chart and donut in plain SVG. No chart library.

list.name: Progress
list.description: Thin progress bar with four tones.

list.name: Alert
list.description: Inline message in info, success, warning and danger.

list.name: Toast
list.description: Call toast.success() from anywhere. No provider needed.

list.name: Skeleton
list.description: Shimmering placeholder for content that is loading.

list.name: Loader
list.description: Six loading animations (ring, dots, bars, pulse, orbit, dual), an indeterminate or determinate bar loader, and a loading overlay.

list.name: Spinner
list.description: Tiny CSS spinner that inherits text color.

list.name: Dialog and Sheet
list.description: Centered modal and edge-docked sheet on Radix Dialog.

list.name: Dropdown menu
list.description: Action menu with checkbox items, shortcuts and destructive items.

list.name: Popover
list.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.

list.name: Tour
list.description: Spotlight a part of the page and step through it with a card, for product walkthroughs.

list.name: Hover card
list.description: Rich preview that opens when you hover or focus a link, for profiles and references.

list.name: Context menu
list.description: Right-click menu with items, shortcuts, checkbox items, labels and nested submenus.

list.name: Tooltip
list.description: Hint on hover and focus. Optional title, keyboard shortcut, light style and arrow, plus an (i) InfoTip and a TruncatedText that only shows a tooltip when cut off.

list.name: Command palette
list.description: Searchable palette on cmdk. Bind it to Ctrl or Cmd K.

list.name: Tabs
list.description: Underline or pill tabs on Radix Tabs.

list.name: Breadcrumb
list.description: Trail of parent pages.

list.name: Pagination
list.description: Page buttons with ellipsis for long ranges.

list.name: Stepper
list.description: Horizontal steps for multi-step forms and onboarding.

list.name: Sidebar
list.description: Collapsible nav with groups, nested links and badges. Icon rail on desktop, slide-over on mobile.

list.name: App shell
list.description: Sidebar, topbar and scrolling content area, plus a page header.

demo.calendar:
<bef-calendar id="cal"></bef-calendar>
<script>document.getElementById('cal').props = { selected: new Date(), onSelect: (d) => console.log('picked', d) };</script>
demo.date-picker:
<bef-date-picker emit="change" clearable style="width:240px"></bef-date-picker>
<bef-date-range-picker id="drp" presets style="width:300px"></bef-date-range-picker>
<script>
  const drp = document.getElementById('drp');
  const setRange = (value) => drp.props = { value, onChange: setRange };
  setRange(undefined);
</script>
demo.virtual-list:
<bef-virtual-list id="vl" style="width:320px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px"></bef-virtual-list>
<script>document.getElementById('vl').props = { items: Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => 'Row ' + (i + 1)), rowHeight: 36, height: 280, renderRow: (t) => t };</script>
demo.uptime-bar:
<bef-uptime-bar id="ub" name="API" class="w-full max-w-xl"></bef-uptime-bar>
<script>document.getElementById('ub').props = { days: Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => ({ date: '2026-08-' + String((i % 28) + 1).padStart(2, '0'), status: i === 12 ? 'down' : i === 40 ? 'degraded' : 'up' })) };</script>
